newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends lower after depreciation.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends lower after depreciation.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.01 lower at 41.21 to the dollar in the kerb market on Tuesday after a central bank lower adjustment, dealers said.
The rupee is likely to open lower on Wednesday, one dealer said.
The State (central) bank of Pakistan adjusted the rupee on Tuesday to 40.3300/40.5317 from 40.2400/40.4412 to the dollar set on April 23.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 2.40 percent compared to the opening at 2.60 percent.
